Ghosts often create unexpected time pressure - Etherealness and Horrific Visage force costly decisions each.

DMs: Set a 5-minute timer each round to remind players of the Ghost's Etherealness and Horrific Visage impact.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Gauntlets Of Might alter your Strength stat - it becomes 18 (+4) while worn.

GMs: Hand out Gauntlets Of Might when players face a challenge needing Strength 18, not as everyday gear.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Zamyra's attack routine overwhelms most defenses - with a +27 to hit and multiple attacks per round.

Judges: exploit Zamyra's 160' fly speed to outmaneuver the party, forcing them to adapt or suffer.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Focus Spells limit action economy - you can't cast another while one is active.

GMs: When a player takes damage, enforce the DC 12 Constitution check immediately to see if their Focus Spell fizzles.

Sack's utility often gets overlooked - it holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

DMs: Use the Sack's 30-pound capacity to creatively solve problems or distract, not as an improvised weapon.

Critical Hits aren't just double damage - they use tables for effects from max damage to severed limbs.

Judges: remind players that Warriors' expanded crit range means more frequent rolls on the crit table for nastier effects.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Judges: Remind your halfling player to deploy their Luck die early, before they forget and regret it.
